name: verl V1 Trainer Mainline & VeRL-Omni v0.3.0
body: Mainline PPO and GRPO reinforcement learning workflows now run exclusively on the V1 Trainer (removing legacy V0). Introduces separate_async rollout scheduling (lending idle trainer GPUs to vLLM/SGLang generation pools via adaptive starvation thresholds), tighter dynamic micro-batch token length bounds, stable 300-step FP8 rollout alignment, and multimodal VLM post-training support via VeRL-Omni v0.3.0.
